name: Huge Addons for Elementor
author: Mahfujur Rahman

sections.description:
Huge Addons for Elementor is a premium-quality toolkit of Elementor widgets and blocks designed to help content creators, designers, and developers build beautiful, interactive pages without writing any code. Each widget is optimized for performance and flexibility, offering a wide range of layout, styling, and animation options that integrate seamlessly with the Elementor editor. Whether you’re showcasing products, building portfolios, or adding dynamic media, Huge Addons gives you the tools to elevate your site in minutes.

Core Widget Collection

The plugin ships with a broad selection of both content‑focused and media‑rich widgets. All widgets are:

  • 100% responsive – mobile, tablet and desktop layouts adapt automatically.
  • Customizable – tweak colors, typography, spacing, hover effects and more through the Elementor panel.
  • Lightweight – scripts and styles are conditionally loaded only when a widget is present on the page.

Included Widgets & Extensions

Free Extensions & Utilities
* Header & Footer Builder – create custom headers and footers using Elementor with seamless theme replacement, sticky effects, and full-site display conditions.
* Extensions Manager – centralized control panel to enable or disable extensions site-wide for maximum performance.
* Image Masking – apply creative SVG & clip-path mask shapes to images with 8+ shape presets (Circle, Hexagon, Diamond, Triangle, Star, Shield, Heart, Blob) or custom SVG uploads, complete with position, size, and hover controls.
* Advanced Tooltips – attach rich, customizable tooltips to any Elementor widget with HTML/image content, 12-position control, hover/click triggers, animations, and theme presets.
* Custom Code Manager – inject site-wide CSS and JS code snippets directly from the admin panel without modifying theme files.

Content Widgets
* Advanced Icon Box – icon‑based callouts with multiple layout styles, hover animations and custom link support.
* Post Grid – display your blog posts, portfolios or custom post types in a masonry/grid layout with filtering and pagination.
* Flip Box – two‑sided boxes that flip on hover with 3 templates (including Template 3 Pricing Cards with individual card background overrides, FontAwesome icon library & custom SVG upload support, and Normal/Hover style tabs).
* Product Carousel – showcase WooCommerce products in a fully responsive slider with sale badges, ratings and add‑to‑cart buttons.
* Button Group – flexible button groups with alignment, icon support, and outline/filled styles.
* Coupon Code – animated coupon code reveal with clipboard copy and expiry countdown.
* Feature Comparison – side-by-side feature comparison table with flexible styling.
* Business Hours – display operating hours with status badges and clean layouts.

Media & Interactive Widgets
* Huge Advanced Image Gallery – build stunning, filterable galleries with lightbox, masonry, justified and slideshow modes.
* Lottie Widget – insert lightweight, scalable Lottie animations using a JSON file or URL; controls for speed, loop and interaction.
* Video Gallery & Popup – open YouTube/Vimeo or self‑hosted videos in customizable grid/lightbox modal overlays.
* Google Map – interactive maps with custom marker pin upload and style JSON theming.

Header & Footer Widgets
* Huge Site Logo – display site logo or custom image with responsive sizing, alignment, caption, link, and styling controls.
* Huge Nav Menu – responsive navigation menu supporting WordPress custom menus, horizontal and vertical layouts, animated submenus, dropdown indicators, and mobile accordion toggle.
* Huge Search – header search form with custom placeholder, search button layout, and style controls.
* Huge Copyright – footer copyright text with dynamic current year tag and site title.
* Huge Page Title – contextual page and archive title heading widget for headers and hero sections.

Utility & UI Widgets
* Testimonials Slider – rotate customer quotes with avatar images and star ratings; 7 layout styles, custom arrow icons, and configurable star icons.
* Huge Testimonial – single testimonial card with 10 layout styles, quote icon, social links, and configurable star icons.
* Logo Carousel – showcase brand logos in a Swiper-powered carousel with 5 design layouts, custom arrow icons, and full card/image/arrow/pagination style controls.
* Huge Teams – team member showcase with multiple layout styles.
* WooCommerce Category List – display WooCommerce categories in a styled list.
* Single Image Scroll – reveal tall images with a smooth scroll interaction.
* Animated Text – GSAP-powered text animations with multiple effects.
* Breadcrumbs – clean, customizable breadcrumb navigation for SEO and site hierarchy.
* Countdown Timer & Countdown Pro – simple event countdowns and flip-clock / circular progress styles.
* Icon List – bullet lists with icon support and custom spacing.

(See the screenshots below for examples of each widget in action.)

All widgets and extensions are fully responsive and designed for easy use with Elementor.

Minimum Requirements

  • WordPress 6.5 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later
  • MySQL 5.0 or later

Recommended Environment

  • PHP 8.1+ for best performance and security
  • MySQL 5.6+ or MariaDB equivalent
  • Elementor (free) 3.15+ – required for all widgets to function

Quick Setup

  1. Upload the entire huge-addons-for-elementor folder to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WordPress plugin installer.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins screen.
  3. Open the Elementor editor on any page; new widget categories labeled Huge Addons will appear in the sidebar.
  4. Drag and drop widgets onto your layout and configure options directly in Elementor’s panel.

Tip: The plugin only enqueues scripts/styles when you place a widget on the page, keeping your front end fast.
sections.faq:
Do I need Elementor to use these widgets?

Yes – Huge Addons is an extension for Elementor. Install the free version of Elementor first, then activate Huge Addons.

Are the widgets mobile friendly?

Absolutely. Every widget has responsive controls built into the Elementor settings, allowing you to adjust text size, spacing and visibility per device.

Will the plugin slow down my site?

No. Scripts and styles are only loaded on pages where a Huge Addons widget has been used. Unused widgets have zero impact.

Can I translate the widget labels?

Yes. The plugin is fully localization‑ready; generate or edit the .pot file in languages/ to provide translations.

How do I report a bug or request a feature?

Head to the support section on the WordPress.org plugin page or open an issue on the GitHub repository (link in the plugin’s dashboard).

1.3.5 – 2026-11-06

  • Fix: Huge Advanced Accordion — resolved click-to-close issue when multiple items open is disabled, fixed live text color contrast on Design 5, sanitized default placeholder texts, added dedicated icon spacing slider, resolved duplicate HTML IDs across multiple instances, added full ARIA accessibility (aria-expanded, aria-controls, role=”region”), added FAQ Schema JSON-LD toggle, and implemented URL hash scroll navigation.
  • Fix: Huge Advanced Icon Box — merged duplicate class attribute resolving hover-state styling bugs, fixed Font Awesome solid star icons rendering on live frontend, corrected Split Row flex alignment, resolved watermark preset activation, normalized border-radius/padding specificity, enabled target=”_blank” and rel=”nofollow” attributes for buttons, added dynamic image icon alt attributes, and added full box clickable link option.
  • Fix: Huge Post Grid — fixed numbered pagination queries for current page offset, resolved Load More script loading and AJAX handler bindings, fixed image fill for Boxed layout and zero-height layout when featured image is missing, enhanced color contrast for text overlays, added Font Awesome icon style dependencies, enabled Read More toggle on Design 5, added author escaping, added aria-label for icon links, and added query controls, masonry layout, and category filter tabs.
  • Fix: Huge Flip Box — resolved 3D flip card transform rendering and height calculation across presets, and improved mobile tap triggers.
  • Fix: Huge Breadcrumbs — corrected minified CSS stylesheet loading path, rendered current page item as plain text, added full archive trail support (categories, tags, authors, dates, custom taxonomies, and WooCommerce products/shop), added BreadcrumbList JSON-LD schema, and added aria-current=”page”.
  • Fix: Huge Animated Text — resolved typography font size and weight CSS specificity overrides, fixed 0s delay fallback, added prefers-reduced-motion media query support, and added HTML heading tag selector.
  • Fix: Huge Nav Menu — resolved mobile accordion submenus, dropdown indicator animations, and responsive wrapper styles.
  • Fix: Header & Footer Widgets — refined typography, search input layout, dynamic copyright tags, and responsive image sizing for Site Logo, Search, Page Title, and Copyright widgets.
  • Fix: Feature Comparison & Business Hours — fixed cell icon buffer rendering, duplicate button hrefs, nested repeater paths, row alignment, custom day labels, and title HTML tags.
  • Improved: Media & UI Widgets — added responsive column controls, HTML heading tag selectors (H1–H6, div, span, p), responsive slide settings, avatar border-radius controls, and Font Awesome stylesheet dependencies across Team Carousel, Team Members, Testimonial, Testimonial Slider, Advanced Image Gallery, Image Parallax, Logo Carousel, Lottie, Single Image Scroll, Product Carousel, and Woo Category List widgets.
  • Updated: Tested compatibility with WordPress 7.1, Elementor 4.3.6, and Elementor Pro 4.3.3.

1.3.4 – 2026-10-28

  • Added: Integration and settings dashboard support for the new Huge Widget Builder Pro extension.
  • Improved: Synchronized notice configurations and admin update checks.
  • Updated: Compatibility checks with WordPress 7.1 and Elementor 4.3.5.

1.3.3 – 2026-10-24

  • Improved: Updated promotional notices with recent releases (Mega Menu, Header & Footer Builder, Accordion Templates, Image Masking, and Conditional Content).
  • Improved: Enhanced promotional notice auto-sync on settings dashboard.
  • Updated: Compatibility checks with WordPress 7.0+ and Elementor 4.3.5.

1.3.2 – 2026-10-21

  • Added: Seamless Mega Menu integration for Huge Nav Menu widget (thha-nav-menu) with Pro NavMenuWalker and dynamic assets loading.
  • Fix: Header & Footer template preview canvas check to prevent editor layout interference during Elementor library/template editing.
  • Improved: Submenu indicators, wrapper classes, and animation triggers for header navigation.

1.3.1 – 2026-10-21

  • Updated: Tested compatibility with Elementor 4.3.5 and Elementor Pro 4.3.2.
  • Refactor: Modernized widget control registration methods to register_controls in Huge Product Carousel and Huge Lottie widgets.
  • Fix: Cleaned up duplicate widget registration in Huge Team Members widget.
  • Fix: Passed all WordPress Plugin Check standards (i18n translators comments, direct nonce validation in AJAX endpoints, and query optimizations).

1.3.0 – 2026-10-09

  • Added: Header & Footer Builder module — build custom headers and footers with Elementor, featuring automatic theme replacement hooks (supporting Hello Elementor, Astra, OceanWP, GeneratePress, Kadence, Neve, Blocksy, and standard WordPress action fallbacks).
  • Added: Display Conditions engine — configure template display rules for Entire Site in the Free version, with extensive Singular, Archive, Post Type, and Page-level targeting available in Pro.
  • Added: Sticky Header feature — enable sticky headers with scroll distance threshold, shrink effects, and background color transitions on scroll.
  • Added: Huge Site Logo widget — display default WordPress custom logo or custom image with responsive sizing, caption, link, and styling controls.
  • Added: Huge Nav Menu widget — responsive navigation menu supporting WordPress custom menus, horizontal and vertical layouts, animated submenus, dropdown indicators, and mobile accordion toggle.
  • Added: Huge Search widget — header search form with customizable layout, placeholder text, submit buttons, and search styles.
  • Added: Huge Copyright widget — footer copyright text with dynamic current year tag, site title, and typography styling.
  • Added: Huge Page Title widget — contextual archive and page title heading widget for headers and hero sections.
  • Added: Custom branded SVG widget icons for all Header & Footer widgets in Elementor panel and settings dashboard.
  • Improved: Performance and modular architecture with conditional asset loading for all Header & Footer builder components.
  • Improved: Cache busting for common styles using filemtime versioning to ensure instant browser asset updates.
  • Updated: Tested compatibility with Elementor 4.3.4 and Elementor Pro 4.3.1.

1.2.9 – 2026-10-03

  • Added: General Style controls section for Huge Advanced Accordion with custom padding, margin, classic/gradient background, border, border radius, and box shadow directly on the root accordion container.
  • Added: Content Type selector allowing accordion items to display either standard content or Elementor Saved Templates.
  • Added: Customizable Animation Duration slider control (100ms–2000ms) for smooth expand and collapse timing.
  • Added: Dedicated expand and collapse icon controls with dynamic active-state icon swapping.
  • Added: Item Spacing responsive slider control and Remove First/Last Border toggle switch under Border & Spacing.
  • Improved: Accordion expand/collapse transition animations with container-level overflow clipping and hardware acceleration to prevent content and overlays from spilling outside rounded corners.
  • Fix: Resolved Preset 3 button display issue when custom URL is not explicitly set.
  • Fix: Removed default focus outline and background highlight overlay from accordion header buttons.
  • Fix: Added robust validation for defaultActive index to prevent negative or out-of-bounds accordion values.
  • Updated: Tested compatibility with Elementor 4.3.3 and Elementor Pro 4.3.1.

1.2.8 – 2026-08-26

  • Added: Optional Content Subtitle field across all Huge Advanced Accordion variations with rich styling controls (Typography, Normal & Hover Color, Margin).
  • Added: Optional Tags / Badges feature for Huge Advanced Accordion items with comma-separated inputs and dedicated style section (Typography, Normal/Hover Colors, Border, Pill Radius, Padding, and Gap).
  • Improved: Accordion content structure — positioned subtitles inside the card content above details/headings for improved hierarchy.
  • Fix: Resolved CSS specificity collisions for Subtitle, Heading Details, and Content styles to ensure Elementor design panel styling overrides apply seamlessly.
  • Updated: Tested compatibility with WordPress and Elementor.

1.2.7 – 2026-08-24

  • Added: Full standalone card layout with individual item borders, border radii, and Box Shadow controls (Normal & Hover) across all Accordion variations.
  • Added: Container Width, Classic/Gradient Background, Glassmorphism Backdrop Blur, Padding, Border, and Shadow controls for background-based accordion variations.
  • Added: Background Overlay settings (Classic & Gradient, Opacity slider, Normal & Hover tabs) for widget-level and hero item backgrounds.
  • Added: Comprehensive Normal/Hover/Active style tabs for Accordion Header Titles, Content Paragraphs, Heading/Details, and Toggle Icons.
  • Added: Button & Link layout positioning controls (Top, Bottom, Left, Right, Alignment, Vertical Alignment, and Gap) with full Normal/Hover styling.
  • Added: Content & Inner Card Glassmorphism Backdrop Blur and custom styling controls for Design 3 & 5.
  • Added: Title HTML Tag (SEO selector) control supporting H1–H6, div, span, and p tags across all accordion variations.
  • Improved: Removed hardcoded SCSS styles and resolved specificity conflicts on Design 5 accordion items.
  • Security: Applied security patches with enhanced input sanitization, strict capability checks, and output escaping.
  • Updated: Tested compatibility with WordPress, Elementor 4.2.3, and Elementor Pro 4.2.2.
